Name: Stumps to Hardwood Stumps
Author: Nishtra
Description:
Originally designed as an extension to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/673/?]Forage at the Farm[/url] mod, but quickly became big enough to be a separate mod.

This mod turns the stumps left after cutting trees into large hardwood stumps adter a 5 day period of time (by default).
Has more cheating potential than simple spawning, but at the same time is less immersion breaking (IMHO).

[i]Note[/i]: the mod uses 2 config files. The first is the general one, it contains basic settings of the mod and is located in the mod folder. The second one saves the location and age of stumps on your farm separately for every character, is located one level deeper in the StumpsCollections folder (it will be created once the ingame day changes for the first time playing with this mod) and I do not recommend doing anything with it (though, nothing should break if you do).

[color=#ff7700]Requires SMAPI!
[/color]
